positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "Our community leads California in oil and natural gas production as well as in renewable energy. Energy production is a major driver of economic activity in Kern County creating new jobs and opportunity. However, onerous regulations and bureaucracy threaten our ability to power our state. In order for our state to thrive, we must have common sense solutions that allow us to meet our energy needs."
Voted against AB 1373 "Appropriates Funding for Various State Clean Energy Programs"

Voted against AB 1440 "Amends State Law Concerning Oil and Gas Extraction."
